scope: Optional receipt protocol, host preservation, full prior/current source-binding checks, live admission refresh, strict revise and separation from historical v1. Includes three actual SQLite/MemoryService/MemoryEvidenceSource flows; no provider model, Task or fee experiment.
confirmed_invariants: An accept wire object has exactly review/action/empty defects and cannot contain a replacement answer/status/source_indices/missing or analysis.
Host acceptance returns the identical original GroundedAnswerDecision object, preserving answer, qualifiers, reason code, policy metadata and every original citation, including navigation.

Each citation must align with a complete original prior binding and have an admitted current snapshot with matching namespace, version, source provenance, role, observation/statement clocks and visible literal quote. Reordering and a same-snapshot passage expansion are permitted.
Missing/forged prior bindings and changed current source refs, lifecycle, namespace, version, role, clock or quote are rejected.

Admission is rechecked before the review prompt and after a completed review response. Real or synthetic revocation fails closed without extra format retry; in-place source mutation cannot rewrite both sides of the preserved comparison.
An explicit source-grounded citation-only revise still uses the original full decision/defect contract; an unlabelled support defect cannot change an ANSWER.
Old ARGUMENT_PROTOCOL remains version argument-grounded-reader-v1 with no receipt resolver or new refresh policy. Original R70 plan/synthesis/review system prompts remain byte-identical.

real_provider_flows.case: SQLite positive with actual plan search/read plus access during synthesis
real_provider_flows.result: ANSWER preserved after four total source accesses (two searches and two reads); memory_access gains at least two rows while memory version/content/created_at/updated_at remain unchanged.
Actual memory tombstone and hard deletion are observed by review preflight annotation; ERROR/EVIDENCE_SOURCE_FAILURE before review, no final answer or citation.
Actual tombstone/deletion are observed after the completed review response; ERROR/EVIDENCE_SOURCE_FAILURE, no final citation or format retry.

finding_history.finding: Review packets previously came only from cached workspace items, so a store revocation between stages could remain invisible to a receipt-only snapshot comparison.
finding_history.disposition: Resolved in new optional orchestration by live annotate before and after review; actual SQLite hard-forget cases and synthetic version/revocation cases pass. Old v1 behavior remains unchanged.

limitations: A model receipt confirms its decision to keep a draft; it is not proof that the source text entails the draft. No new semantic accuracy or 95% result is established.

The real provider tests cover SQLite only, not PostgreSQL or a multi-process storage race. Source adapters without a live annotate capability remain responsible for admission when supplying caller-trusted evidence.
Factory integration, full engineering gates, installed package and real new-generation evaluation need separate root evidence; this independent review does not replace them.
